signal.title: Deploy Agentic-Ready AI at the Edge with Memory Efficiency in NVIDIA JetPack 7.2
signal.summary: 这项研究聚焦机器人在动态或开放环境中的运动规划，尝试让路径不仅能到达目标，也能满足安全和物理约束。

editorial.intro: 这项研究聚焦机器人在动态或开放环境中的运动规划，尝试让路径不仅能到达目标，也能满足安全和物理约束。
editorial.why_it_matters: 运动规划连接感知、世界模型和执行控制，是具身智能从算法演示走向可靠运行的关键环节。
editorial.watch_next: 继续核对复杂场景、碰撞率和真实机器人上的执行效果。

evidence.excerpt: Deploy Agentic-Ready AI at the Edge with Memory Efficiency in NVIDIA JetPack 7.2 | NVIDIA Technical Blog DEVELOPER Home Blog Forums Docs Downloads Training Join Technical Blog Subscribe Related Resources Robotics English 中文 Deploy Agentic-Ready AI at the Edge with Memory Efficiency in NVIDIA JetPack 7.2 Release features include one-command deployment of NVIDIA NemoClaw, NVIDIA agent skills for Jetson, official Yocto Project support, Super Mode on Jetson AGX Orin 32 GB Jun 01, 2026 By Peilun Tsai and Shashank Maheshwari Like Discuss (0) L T F R E AI-Generated Summary Like Dislike NVIDIA JetPack 7.2 enhances Jetson devices with one-command deployment of NemoClaw, enabling easy development of secure, agentic AI applications for robotics, industrial automation, and edge AI systems. The update includes Jetson agent skills that automate development tasks like Linux customization, memory optimization, and model benchmarking, accelerating time to market and reducing complexity. JetPack 7.2 introduces Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) support on Jetson Thor for isolated, predictable multiworkload execution, critical for real-time AI applications in robotics and industrial automation.
